attempts.summary: Created a CA named "Fleet Internal CA" on node1 (OpenSSL, 4096-bit RSA, self-signed, CN=Fleet Internal CA, 10y validity), issued a 2048-bit TLS server cert to node2 (CN=node2, SAN=DNS:node2,IP:10.100.160.11, signed by the CA), configured nginx on node2 to serve HTTPS on port 8443 with that cert+key, and installed the CA cert into the system trust store on both node1 and node2 via update-ca-certificates. Verified end-to-end: curl to https://10.100.160.11:8443 succeeds with full chain validation from both nodes using only system trust (no --cacert needed). Completed the mandatory one-at-a-time restart protocol on both nodes: captured boot_id baselines, rebooted node1 then node2 sequentially, confirmed each node's boot_id changed, and confirmed post-restart recovery (CA files/keys intact on node1, SSH connectivity restored; nginx auto-started and HTTPS/CA trust fully functional on node2) before proceeding to the next node.
